posts.zh:
dsh-liquid-glass-balance-card 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-57b860a557c11f1f37e2.html
posts.en:
dsh-liquid-glass-balance-card is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-57b860a557c11f1f37e2.html
